tools.name: angel_intelligence

tools.name: due_diligence

tools.name: check_report_status
tools.description: Check the status of an intelligence run by its run_id, and retrieve the full report once it is completed. Free.

tools.name: wait_for_report
tools.description: Poll an intelligence run until status is completed/failed/partial or timeout_seconds elapses (default 8, max 12). Returns the latest report payload (timed_out:true is success — call again or use check_report_status). Free — does not debit credits.

tools.name: verify_provenance
tools.description: Return the cryptographic provenance chain for a report so its content can be independently verified. Free. Integrity ≠ factual truth.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Return the current credit balance for the authenticated account. Free.

tools.name: estimate_credits
tools.description: Estimate credit cost before starting a run. Pass tool (MCP name, e.g. angel_intelligence) or endpoint (REST, e.g. angel-report). Omit both for the debiting catalog. Free — does not debit.

tools.description: Lists Groq models this server can bill, with upstream rates and the platform markup.

tools.description: Published markup and per-tool prices. This call is free.

tools.description: Groq chat completion. Authorize the published maximum with x402 upto. After a valid result the server settles the larger of the model floor ($0.005 on gpt-oss-20b, $0.05 on gpt-oss-120b) and actual tokens plus markup, never more than the authorization. Failed or empty results are not charged.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kyb_verify, screen_content · Private data: vault_search, kyb_verify, notary_hash, frontdoor_request_booking, chat_completion · Public sink: screen_content, notary_hash, frontdoor_request_booking, desk_companies · Destructive: company_intelligence, market_intelligence, angel_intelligence, angel_deep_intelligence, due_diligence, security_assessment, vault_search, kyb_verify, screen_content, classify_entities, check_report_status, wait_for_report, estimate_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kyb_verify, screen_content · Private data: vault_search, kyb_verify, notary_hash, frontdoor_request_booking, chat_completion · Public sink: screen_content, notary_hash, frontdoor_request_booking, desk_companies · Destructive: company_intelligence, market_intelligence, angel_intelligence, angel_deep_intelligence, due_diligence, security_assessment, vault_search, kyb_verify, screen_content, classify_entities, check_report_status, wait_for_report, estimate_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
